name: Nx
tagline: A build system and workspace toolkit for monorepos and their plugins.
hook: A workspace guide to planning, generated sections, docs, affected-project tests, E2E checks, and external package testing.
summary: Nx's AGENTS.md contains contributor workflows and a generated workspace section. It sends documentation work to the Astro site guide, distinguishes issue analysis from implementation, and explains how to test local packages in another repository.

techniques.title: Select a work mode from the request
techniques.body: The issue-response section defaults analytical or ambiguous requests to a plan and reserves immediate implementation for explicit action requests. The file makes this distinction before describing the issue workflow.
techniques.quote:
### Plan-First Mode (Default)

Use this approach when users ask you to:

- "analyze", "investigate", "assess", "review", "examine", or "plan"
- Or when the request is ambiguous

techniques.title: Expand validation through the dependency graph
techniques.body: The testing sequence begins with the specific project, then affected projects, and finally affected E2E tests. Each stage adds evidence beyond the directly edited package.

techniques.title: Provide an external-consumer test workflow
techniques.body: A dedicated command builds and copies a local package into another repository. The guide explicitly says this includes native Rust code, so integration testing is not limited to JavaScript-only packages.
techniques.quote: This builds the package and copies it into the target repo's `node_modules`. It works for all packages including native Rust code.

techniques.title: Route scaffolding before exploration
techniques.body: The generated Nx block assigns generator discovery to a skill that must run before workspace exploration or MCP calls. It also distinguishes advanced documentation questions from basic generator syntax already handled by that skill.
techniques.quote: - For scaffolding tasks (creating apps, libs, project structure, setup), ALWAYS invoke the `nx-generate` skill FIRST before exploring or calling MCP tools

steal: Distinguish investigation requests from implementation requests.
Expand testing from changed components to their dependents.
Provide a repeatable way to test a local package in a consumer repository.
Load task-specific discovery guidance before using generic exploration tools.
